purpose: Single Redirect rules for saltcitydefense.com. The site is GitHub Pages behind Cloudflare, so _redirects is not supported and redirects live at the Cloudflare edge. This file documents them; it is not read by anything.
plan_limit: Cloudflare Free plan: 10 Single Redirect rules

ruleset.evaluation: top to bottom; the first matching rule redirects and stops

rules.expression: http.request.uri.path ne "/" and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/") and not (http.request.uri.path contains ".") and not (http.request.uri.path in {"/dui-defense/" "/criminal-defense/" "/our-firm/"}) and ((http.request.uri.path wildcard "/*/" and not http.request.uri.path wildcard "/*/*/") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/blog/*/" and not http.request.uri.path wildcard "/blog/*/*/"))

http.request.uri.path ne "/" and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/") and not (http.request.uri.path contains ".") and not (http.request.uri.path in {"/dui-defense" "/criminal-defense" "/our-firm"}) and ((http.request.uri.path wildcard "/*" and not http.request.uri.path wildcard "/*/*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/blog/*" and not http.request.uri.path wildcard "/blog/*/*"))

design_notes: Rules 1-5 are placed BEFORE 'Strip trailing slash' so the one-hop redirect wins.
Generic rules 1 and 2 match only paths with no dot anywhere, never '/', and only top-level paths or /blog/<slug>; sitemap.xml, robots.txt, images, css, js and every .html URL are never matched.
Rules 1 and 2 exclude /dui-defense, /criminal-defense and /our-firm (exact match) so rules 3 and 5 can handle the first two and /our-firm stays a plain 404.
Rules 3-5 are exact-match lists, with and without a trailing slash.
?page_id=, ?feed= and ?s= URLs are on '/', which no rule matches, so they are untouched.

intentionally_not_redirected.note: serves 200 with canonical '/'; internal links now point to '/'; no redirect by decision
old WordPress page; left as 404 by decision (would map to /about.html)
old WordPress page; left as 404 by decision (would map to /contact.html)
old WordPress page; left as 404 by decision (would map to /disclaimer.html)
serve the homepage with canonical '/'; page-id mapping unknown

known_side_effects: Any unknown top-level or /blog/<slug> path without a dot (for example /zzz) now returns one 301 to /zzz.html, which then 404s. Real pages are unaffected.
adding_a_new_blog_post: No rule change needed: /blog/<new-slug> and /blog/<new-slug>/ are covered by rules 1 and 2 as soon as <new-slug>.html exists.
testing_method: Each rule was first created with an extra condition `and any(http.request.headers["x-redirect-test"][*] eq "on")`, tested with curl -H 'x-redirect-test: on', then the condition was removed and everything retested without the header. A new or changed rule should be staged the same way.

rollback.before_state: The ruleset before this work held only 'Strip trailing slash'. A copy of that ruleset is kept outside this repo on the maintainer's machine (~/.cloudflare_scd_ruleset_rollback_2026-11-13.json).
rollback.disable_one_rule: Cloudflare dashboard > Rules > Redirect Rules > toggle the rule off, or PATCH /zones/<ZONE_ID>/rulesets/<ruleset_id above>/rules/<rule_id> with the rule body and "enabled": false.
rollback.full_rollback: Cloudflare dashboard > Rules > Redirect Rules > delete rules 1-5, or PUT /zones/<ZONE_ID>/rulesets/phases/http_request_dynamic_redirect/entrypoint with the rules from the saved before-state copy.
rollback.zone_id: Find <ZONE_ID> on the zone's Overview page in the Cloudflare dashboard. It is intentionally not stored here. API calls need a zone-scoped token that is never stored in the repo.
